zh: 需要介绍真实机器人实验的硬件、本体、末端、目标物体及场景相对位置
论文的 Experimental Setup / Implementation Details 需要读者快速理解环境
对外展示实体工作台、设备配置与视觉定位标志
en: Explaining the hardware, gripper, task objects and workspace geometry of a real robot setup
Writing an Experimental Setup / Implementation Details illustration
Presenting a physical workcell, equipment and fiducial markers

zh: 以完整实拍建立事实基底，仅用少量贴近实体的白底标注叠加说明，不用图标替代真实设备
同时标出机器人本体、执行器、任务对象及定位标志，让读者理解可操作空间
摄影图承担场景真实性，简洁文字承担语义索引；标注应避开关键交互位置并保持可读
en: Use an actual photo as the factual base, with small, clearly placed labels rather than symbolic hardware icons
Identify embodiment, end-effector, task objects and fiducials together to communicate reachable workspace
Separate visual evidence from semantic callouts; keep labels away from important contacts

zh: 真实照片与标签只证明实验环境存在，不证明任务成功、定位精度或安全避障能力
如果场景极其拥挤，可分成总览与一张局部放大图，不要堆积数十个标签
借鉴标注方法而不是把第三方实验室照片当作自己的实验图；外链不等于转载许可
en: A labeled photo does not establish success rates, calibration quality or collision avoidance
For crowded workcells, separate a wide shot and close-up rather than adding dozens of callouts
Reuse the annotation approach, not another lab's photo as evidence of your own experiment

insight.zh: 优秀之处不在视觉特效，而是单张真实照片实现高信息密度、低解释成本、明确硬件身份与场景语义。
insight.en: Its strength is not special effects but dense, low-friction grounding of hardware identity and task context in a single authentic image.

zh: 实物照片充满画面，机械臂占左侧视觉主线，桌面任务环境占右侧与前景
白底黑字的小型标签直接贴近对象，统一样式降低识读成本
动作对象、操作器和定位标志同时在画面内，可作为实验可复现信息的索引
en: The arm anchors the left side while the workcell and task objects occupy the right and foreground
Consistent white labels immediately identify each part without redesigning the actual scene
Actuators, objects and fiducials appear together as a reproducibility-oriented index

zh: 选择真实实验的一张无遮挡全景，确认所有关键硬件可辨认
统一镜头/视角后用矢量文字框标注：机器人型号、末端、主要场景物体与定位装置
在 caption 独立说明拍摄来源、实验任务和没有由图片证明的技术指标
en: Capture one unobstructed real workcell overview
Overlay editable callouts naming the robot, end-effector, main objects and fiducials
Caption the provenance, task context and metrics the photograph cannot demonstrate
